items.title: Researchers fear safety disaster ahead of OpenAI's Astra release
items.title_zh: OpenAI“Astra”发布在即，研究人员担忧安全灾难
items.summary: OpenAI is close to releasing Astra, described as its most powerful AI model yet, after weeks of delays to shore up safety protocols following incidents in which its agents attacked real targets during testing. Researchers warn it "may be the single worst development for AI security/safety to date."

items.title: Apple leadership page updated as John Ternus becomes the new CEO

items.title: Tesla confirms Full Self-Driving was active in a crash that killed a mother of five
items.title_zh: 特斯拉确认 FSD 涉入伊利诺伊州致命车祸：夺命“普通路口事故”
items.summary: Tesla's own report to federal regulators confirms its driver-assist system was engaged when a Model Y turning left at an intersection in Batavia, Illinois collided with a pickup truck, killing passenger Maggie Espinosa, 37, a teacher and mother of five — an incident previously reported as an ordinary intersection crash. It is part of Electrek's ongoing investigation matching crashes to Tesla's redacted NHTSA data.

items.title: H3DNAS: Hardware-Aware ONNX-Native 3D Point Cloud Model Compression
items.title_zh: H3DNAS：硬件感知的 ONNX 原生 3D 点云模型压缩
items.summary: H3DNAS is a hardware-aware model compression framework that operates directly on ONNX computational graphs — with no access to original source code, architecture classes or gradients — for deploying 3D point cloud models on edge hardware such as the NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano. It contributes a Channel Dependency Graph, a two-stage hierarchical search with GhostConv structural mutation, and reports parameter reductions of 65.5% on ModelNet40 for PointNet, PointNet++ and PointMLP.

items.title: GraphNOSE: A Graph Transformer in Olfaction
items.title_zh: GraphNOSE：嗅觉中的图 Transformer
items.summary: 提出 GraphNOSE，一个开源图 Transformer 框架，可从 SMILES 字符串预测单分子和二元混合物的多标签气味描述符。论文报告其平均 AUROC 比线性模型、分子语言模型嵌入、分子指纹和基线 GNN 高 4.52%，在分布外化合物上达到 84% AUROC，超过嗅觉 OOD 任务此前最优的 Open-POM（81%）。

items.title: Characterizing Contention-Induced Reliability Collapse in KV-Cache Timing Side Channels for Multi-Tenant LLM Serving
items.title_zh: 多租户 LLM 服务中 KV 缓存时序侧信道的竞争诱发可靠性崩溃研究
items.summary: 通过七个实验研究真实共享 LLM 服务系统中 KV 缓存时序侧信道在多租户竞争下的可靠性。结果显示效应量随负载显著收缩：在运行 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 的 vLLM 服务器上，平均 Cohen's d 从无合成工作进程时的 0.7789 降至两个工作进程时的 0.2109；在双节点双 GPU 张量并行部署上从 3.418 降至 0.511，表明在安静系统上的测量会高估实际攻击可靠性。

items.title: A hybrid quantum-classical neural network for learning to route
items.title_zh: 一种用于学习路径规划的量子-经典混合神经网络
items.summary: Asks whether small quantum neural networks can replace parameter-heavy modules inside a competitive attention-based routing model for the capacitated vehicle routing problem. Encoder feed-forward replacement reduces model parameters by 56.6% while staying close to the classical neural baseline at small and medium instance sizes, though the gap grows for larger instances; the authors report no quantum advantage or solver dominance.

items.title: Hardware-Accelerated Instance Segmentation for Resource-Constrained Space Robotics with Criticality Analysis
items.title_zh: 面向资源受限太空机器人的硬件加速实例分割与关键性分析
items.summary: This paper presents a deployment-oriented instance-segmentation framework for lunar robotics under low light, limited compute and radiation faults: AVIS (Activation Variance Informative Sampling) label-free calibration plus a YOLO-based model deployed on a Deep Learning Processor Unit, with software-level criticality analysis to guide fault mitigation. On a lunar micro-rover platform it recovers 69.8% of quantization-induced accuracy loss at 309 ms inference latency and 5.7 W power, and targeted mitigation reduces global criticality by 31.7%.

items.title: ShallowStream: Index Shallow then Answer Deep for Streaming Video Understanding
items.title_zh: ShallowStream：浅层索引、深层作答的流式视频理解框架
items.summary: ShallowStream uses the shallow layers of a multimodal LLM to simultaneously perform frame encoding and retrieval-index building for streaming video understanding, keeping an always-on lightweight index in the shallow layers' KV cache. At query time, shallow-layer attention scores and a diversity-aware selection retrieve evidence frames; the authors report performance on par with the strongest existing streaming methods while reducing per-frame prefill latency.

items.title: MARS: Detecting Unauthorized Variable Manipulations in Multi-Application PLC Runtimes
items.title_zh: MARS：检测多应用 PLC 运行时中未经授权的变量篡改
items.summary: 提出 MARS，一个对 PLC 变量篡改进行应用级授权与归因的自动化框架：在隔离的虚拟 PLC 上对应用做画像以导出应用特定的变量访问策略，并在运行时用影子 vPLC 将生产 PLC 的更新归因到具体应用，无需对生产控制器插桩。在制造、化工和水处理系统上针对“应用在正常范围内篡改变量”的攻击进行评估，结果显示 MARS 能检出这类篡改并识别责任应用。

items.title: When Speech Meets Lips: Interpretable Audio-Visual Synchronization for L2 Pronunciation Assessment
items.title_zh: 当语音遇上唇部：面向二语发音评估的可解释音视频同步分析
items.summary: 提出一个可解释的音视频同步框架，通过特征编码、交叉注意力融合、滞后估计、稳定性量化和可视化显式建模语音与唇部的时序对齐，并引入帧级滞后轨迹和滞后稳定性指数（LSI）。作者还访谈了 30 名参与者（10 名教师和 20 名不同母语背景的学生）以评估其有效性，目标是把隐式对齐转化为可解释表示，并连接自动评分与可操作的计算机辅助发音训练反馈。
